content:
The wait between Severance's first two seasons was already long enough, and the third season is testing viewers' patience just as much — but Apple TV has just released a major update on the show's progress.

"Severance" Season 3 has officially begun filming and is expected to premiere in late 2027

It has been over 18 months since "Severance" Season 2 premiered. While the progress of Season 3 may not be as swift as everyone would like, it has just reached an important milestone.

According to a post by Ben Stiller on X, reposted by the official Apple TV account, "Severance" Season 3 has officially begun filming.

A low-resolution behind-the-scenes photo shared by Stiller appears to show Mark S. and Helly R. running through a Lumon corridor, echoing the iconic scene from the Season 2 finale.

In the Season 2 finale, Mark made a shocking decision, choosing to stay with Helly and going against his outie's original plan to reunite with Gemma, setting the stage for a gripping Season 3 storyline.

There was a three-year gap between "Severance" Seasons 1 and 2, due to factors including script revisions, reshoots, and the Hollywood strikes.

If Season 3 requires 6 to 9 months of production, followed by 6 months of post-production work, "Severance" is most likely to return in autumn 2027 — approximately three years after the previous season.

When do you expect "Severance" Season 3 to premiere? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.

Apple TV's monthly subscription is priced at US$12.99, with discount available when subscribing via the Apple One bundle.
